frameworks_integrated: St. Gallen Business Model Navigator (Magic Triangle)

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: End-consumers seeking convenience, broad selection, and competitive pricing without visiting physical retail.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: 24/7 access, personalized recommendations, vast SKU selection, fast delivery.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Digital storefronts, performance marketing, 3PL/fulfillment networks, data analytics, CRM systems.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Arbitrage between wholesale/manufacturing cost and retail willingness-to-pay; margin capture via operational efficiency.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers and businesses seeking continuous access, predictability, and zero maintenance burden.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Peace of mind, continuous updates, curation, access-over-ownership, reduced decision fatigue.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Cloud infrastructure, automated billing engines, content/product pipelines, customer success teams, churn analytics.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Predictable MRR/ARR, negative working capital cycles, compounding Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Price-sensitive mass market (free tier) AND high-value power users willing to pay for premium utility.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Zero barrier to entry for the base; premium features, status, removal of friction, or enhanced capacity for paying users.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Cross-subsidization, artificial friction via versioning, digital goods replication at zero marginal cost, behavioral UX design.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Massive top-of-funnel acquisition at near-zero cost, monetized by converting a small percentage of high-LTV users.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Customers with variable, unpredictable usage needs who want to avoid fixed commitments or CapEx.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Perfect alignment of cost with value consumed; zero waste; instant scalability.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: IoT metering, automated usage tracking, dynamic provisioning, real-time billing engines, API integrations.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Usage-based revenue scales linearly with consumption; captures surplus from high-frequency users while attracting low-volume adopters.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Price-sensitive, socially conscious, or experimentally-minded buyers; artists/creators seeking goodwill.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Psychological empowerment, fairness, social signaling, community goodwill.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Zero-friction checkout, psychological anchoring, suggested price ranges, community trust mechanisms.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Voluntary surplus capture, viral PR, market research on true willingness-to-pay, goodwill generation.

primary_risks: Brand devaluation if perceived as cheap

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Two or more interdependent groups: Producers/Sellers AND Consumers/Buyers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Liquidity, matchmaking, trust/safety, reduction of transaction friction, discovery.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Platform engineering, API ecosystems, algorithmic matching, community moderation, payment orchestration.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Take rates (commissions), listing fees, premium placement, data monetization, advertising on platform.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Early adopters, niche communities, and socially motivated backers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Early access to innovative products, sense of purpose, community involvement, exclusive rewards.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Campaign marketing, escrow payment orchestration, community management, fulfillment logistics.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Pre-sales capital without equity dilution, risk-free demand validation, community building as marketing.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Publishers, influencers, niche site owners seeking monetization; Advertisers seeking performance-based reach.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: For Affiliates: Revenue without product creation. For Advertisers: Scalable, pay-for-performance acquisition.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Tracking pixels, payout orchestration, partner portals, attribution models, creative asset distribution.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Commission on converted sales (CPA/CPS); advertiser pays only for results; affiliate earns passive income.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Niche consumers, impulse buyers, social media-driven shoppers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Broad product selection, trending items, competitive pricing, zero inventory risk for the seller.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: API supplier integration, digital marketing funnels, CS outsourcing, automated order routing.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Margin arbitrage between wholesale supplier cost and retail price without holding inventory CapEx.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Entrepreneurs seeking proven business systems with reduced risk; Brand owners seeking capital-efficient expansion.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Risk reduction, brand equity, operational blueprints, training, marketing support, proven unit economics.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Standard operating procedures (SOPs), legal frameworks, brand policing, training academies, supply chain agreements.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Upfront franchise fees, recurring royalties (% of gross revenue), supply chain markups, real estate lease arbitrage.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers valuing personal relationships, demonstrations, and trust-based purchasing.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Personalized selling, product demonstrations, word-of-mouth trust, community experience.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Independent sales rep networks, motivational events, CRM systems, home party formats, social selling.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High-margin direct sales without retail overhead; commission-based compensation aligns incentives.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Brands and retailers needing fast time-to-market without R&D investment.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Focus on marketing/brand, lower R&D costs, instant product catalog, speed to shelf.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Contract manufacturing, QA/QC, brand packaging, private label logistics, supplier relationship management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Margin on branded goods without factory CapEx; brand premium over generic equivalents.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Businesses needing proven IP, characters, technology, or brand affinity without in-house development.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Risk reduction, instant brand recognition, market fit, access to beloved characters/patents.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Legal frameworks, IP policing, royalty auditing, brand guidelines enforcement, licensee support.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High-margin passive income via royalties; brand expansion into new categories without CapEx.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Customers needing temporary utility without ownership burden, maintenance, or depreciation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Flexibility, access to premium assets, elimination of maintenance/depreciation, instant availability.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Asset procurement, IoT tracking, dynamic scheduling, reverse logistics, maintenance networks.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Yield management, maximizing asset utilization rates, residual value capture, recurring rental income.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Enterprises and executives needing specialized expertise, objective strategy, or change management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Objective external perspective, niche skills, proven frameworks, risk mitigation, prestige signaling.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Talent acquisition (top graduates), knowledge management systems, client delivery teams, thought leadership.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High-margin billable hours, premium expertise pricing, retainer stability, performance bonuses.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Individuals and teams seeking personal/professional growth, accountability, and transformation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Structured guidance, accountability, personalized feedback, community, proven frameworks.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Curriculum design, 1-on-1 or group delivery, digital platforms, community management, certification programs.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High perceived value, scalable group/digital tiers, recurring relationships, premium pricing for transformation.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Companies seeking cost arbitrage, focus on core competencies, or access to specialized skills.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Lower operational costs, focus on core business, access to global talent, scalability.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Global talent pools, SLA management, secure IT infrastructure, process standardization, knowledge transfer.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Labor cost arbitrage, scalable B2B contracts, recurring service revenue, margin on managed services.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Businesses lacking in-house specialized marketing, creative, or technology capabilities.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Creative premium, cross-industry learning, execution speed, strategic counsel, talent access.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Talent aggregation, creative processes, client servicing teams, media buying relationships, project management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Retainer stability, project premiums, media margin/commission, performance bonuses.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers and professionals seeking instant knowledge, utility, or entertainment delivery.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Zero shipping, instant gratification, infinite scalability, global accessibility.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Content creation, digital storefronts, DRM, automated delivery, email marketing funnels.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Zero marginal cost per unit, infinite inventory, global reach, high gross margins (80-95%).

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Distributors, retailers, B2B buyers, or end-consumers requiring physical goods.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Tangible utility, quality consistency, availability, innovation, brand trust.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Raw material sourcing, factory operations, QA/QC, global logistics, wholesale distribution, R&D.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Economies of scale, cost-plus pricing, volume rebates, supply chain arbitrage, IP premiums.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Retailers, small businesses, and institutions needing bulk inventory with logistics support.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Logistics expertise, credit terms, broad assortment, just-in-time delivery, market access.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Warehousing, fleet management, B2B sales force, inventory financing, category management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Volume sales margins, channel control, logistics service fees, inventory financing spreads.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Markets with supply/demand imbalances; buyers seeking foreign goods at arbitrage prices.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Access to foreign goods, geographic arbitrage, product diversification, trade finance.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Customs brokerage, freight forwarding, FX hedging, trade compliance, international logistics.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Geographic arbitrage margins, trade finance spreads, currency hedging gains, volume throughput.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Two or more companies seeking shared risk, market access, or complementary capabilities.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Synergies, shared CapEx, local market navigation, combined IP, risk mitigation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Legal structuring, joint governance, shared operations, combined R&D, co-marketing.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Expanded TAM, shared risk, accelerated innovation, access to restricted markets.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Passionate users, niche communities, and brand advocates seeking influence and recognition.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Purpose, creative influence, early access, community belonging, recognition.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Gamified platforms, API integrations, community moderation, voting mechanisms, IP assignment frameworks.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Zero marginal R&D cost, pre-validated market demand, community-driven marketing, reduced innovation risk.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Developers and engineering teams needing infrastructure abstraction to focus on code.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Zero server management, instant scalability, developer experience, ecosystem integrations.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Cloud orchestration, API maintenance, developer support, documentation, marketplace add-ons.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High switching costs, ecosystem lock-in, usage-based revenue, developer community network effects.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Businesses and professionals needing continuous software access without maintenance burden.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Continuous updates, cloud access, collaboration, zero maintenance, integrations.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Cloud infrastructure, automated billing, customer success teams, feature R&D, onboarding.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Predictable MRR/ARR, negative working capital, compounding LTV, high gross margins (70-90%).

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Enterprises and developers needing raw compute, storage, and networking on demand.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Infinite scalability, CapEx-to-OpEx shift, global availability, compliance certifications.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Data centers, network backbones, virtualization, API management, compliance automation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Massive scale economies, utility pricing, high barrier to entry, recurring consumption revenue.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Heterogeneous buyer segments with different willingness-to-pay, urgency, or price sensitivity.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Personalized pricing, segment-specific value capture, market expansion to price-sensitive buyers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Segment identification, rate fences, dynamic rules, data analytics, behavioral targeting.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Yield optimization, capturing diverse willingness-to-pay, maximizing revenue per available unit.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Asset owners seeking monetization of idle capacity AND users seeking access without ownership.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Monetize idle assets, access without ownership, community trust, sustainability.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Trust/safety systems, matching algorithms, payment orchestration, review systems, insurance.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Asset-light scaling, network effects, take rates on transactions, data monetization.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: E-commerce sellers needing Prime eligibility, outsourced logistics, and Amazon's customer trust.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Prime badge, 2-day shipping, outsourced CS/returns, Amazon's customer trust.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Amazon warehouse integration, inventory forecasting, FBA fee optimization, Buy Box management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High volume throughput, platform dependency margin, Prime conversion lift, logistics outsourcing.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers needing immediate fulfillment of tasks, deliveries, or services.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Convenience premium, instant gratification, flexible labor access.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Algorithmic dispatch, gig-worker network, payment orchestration, real-time tracking.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: High frequency, convenience markup, flexible labor model, network effects.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Mobile gamers and app users seeking progression, status, or friction removal.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Progression acceleration, cosmetic status, friction removal, exclusive content.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Micro-transaction rails, behavioral UX design, psychological hooks, gamification.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Micro-transaction scale, high LTV from 'whales', frictionless impulse purchases.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Advertisers (B2B) seeking targeted reach; Consumers (B2C) seeking free content/entertainment.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: For Advertisers: Targeted reach, conversion, brand affinity. For Users: Free content.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Algorithmic feeds, content aggregation, data profiling, ad-tech infrastructure, real-time bidding.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Arbitrage between cost of content acquisition and CPM/CPC ad revenue; data monetization.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Frequent purchasers, brand loyalists, and status-seeking consumers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Rewards, status recognition, exclusive access, personalized offers, switching cost creation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Point ledger systems, tier management, partner integrations, data analytics, personalized offers.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Increased purchase frequency, data collection, LTV lift, reduced churn, partner revenue.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Convenience seekers, bargain hunters, and customers with negatively correlated valuations.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Perceived savings, reduced transaction friction, curated experience, one-stop solution.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Package design, cross-sell logic, inventory pairing, pricing architecture, UX simplification.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Increases AOV, moves slow inventory, reduces price sensitivity, captures consumer surplus.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Hobbyists, gig-workers, communities, and domain experts seeking purpose or micro-earnings.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Purpose, micro-earnings, gamification, community, skill development.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Platform governance, API integrations, QA systems, community moderation, incentive design.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Low cost labor/ideas, massive scale, community engagement, zero fixed payroll.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Buyers seeking cost reduction; Suppliers competing for contracts.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Market clearing, transparency, cost reduction, competitive tension.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Bidding engines, supplier verification, escrow, real-time bid tracking, contract automation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Cost reduction via competitive tension, market clearing, transparency, procurement efficiency.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Creators seeking audience/monetization AND consumers seeking entertainment/information.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Infinite content supply, high engagement, community, authentic voices.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Moderation AI, recommendation algorithms, creator funds, content delivery networks.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Infinite supply at zero marginal cost, network effects, ad monetization, data monetization.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers seeking unique experiences, status, and products tailored to their preferences.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Premium utility, status, reduced returns, emotional connection, one-of-a-kind products.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Data pipelines, flexible manufacturing, recommendation AI, customization interfaces.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Premium pricing, high loyalty, reduced returns, data collection, emotional switching costs.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Individuals seeking entrepreneurship/side-income; End-consumers of niche products.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Business-in-a-box, community, personal development, specialized products.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Recruitment funnels, motivational events, decentralized P2P selling, compensation plans.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Zero fixed payroll, viral distribution, high-margin proprietary consumables.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Interdependent user groups where each additional user increases value for all.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Increasing returns to scale, liquidity, community, winner-take-all dynamics.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Platform engineering, chicken-and-egg acquisition, viral loops, ecosystem governance.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Winner-take-all dynamics, high barriers to entry, organic growth, data network effects.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Brands needing affinity and reach; Events/organizations needing funding.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Brand equity lift, targeted reach, halo effect, emotional connection.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Event/creator negotiation, activation campaigns, measurement, content integration.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Brand affinity, targeted reach, halo effect, emotional connection, media value.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Price-sensitive and time-sensitive buyers; businesses with perishable or variable inventory.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Real-time price optimization, supply/demand balancing, yield maximization.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Real-time data pipelines, ML pricing models, rule engines, competitor monitoring.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Maximizes yield, balances supply/demand, profit optimization, captures willingness-to-pay.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Enterprise B2B buyers, luxury consumers, and customers with high willingness-to-pay.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Maximum margin capture, brand prestige, decoupled from costs, perceived value alignment.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Deep customer insight, value metric alignment, willingness-to-pay research, premium positioning.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Maximum margin, brand prestige, decoupled from costs, captures true perceived value.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Businesses and consumers needing long-term asset utility without full ownership.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Predictable cash flow, tax benefits, residual value capture, lower upfront cost.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Asset procurement, credit underwriting, maintenance contracts, residual value management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Residual value capture, predictable cash flow, tax benefits, interest margin.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Collectors, liquidators, unique item seekers, and price-discovery markets.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: True price discovery, urgency creation, clears unique inventory, competitive excitement.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Bidding platforms, authentication, escrow, real-time bid tracking, lot management.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: True price discovery, urgency, clears unique inventory, commission on final price.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Buyers needing immediate ownership; sellers needing liquidity or balance sheet clearing.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Immediate cash injection, clears balance sheet, simple execution, one-time value capture.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Valuation, legal transfer, broker networks, due diligence, settlement.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Immediate cash injection, clears balance sheet, one-time value capture.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Clients needing guaranteed effort, fairness, and transparent compensation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Guarantees compensation for effort, simple to track, perceived fairness.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Time tracking software, billing engines, project management, timesheet approval.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Guarantees compensation for effort, simple, fair, predictable revenue.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Complementary businesses seeking shared growth, audience access, or innovation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Audience sharing, cost sharing, innovation synergy, expanded TAM.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: API integrations, joint GTM strategies, co-marketing, shared data lakes, co-selling.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Expanded TAM, shared risk, accelerated innovation, audience access.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Competitors in the same industry seeking market consolidation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Market share dominance, economies of scale, reduced competition, combined IP.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: M&A execution, culture integration, synergy realization, combined operations.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Market share dominance, scale, reduced competition, pricing power.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Companies seeking supply chain control, margin capture, or quality assurance.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Supply chain control, margin capture, quality assurance, reduced dependency.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: M&A execution, operational integration, transfer pricing, supply chain orchestration.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Supply chain control, margin capture, quality assurance, reduced supplier dependency.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Consumers seeking entertainment; Brands needing affinity and engagement.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Ad-blocker proof, deep engagement, brand affinity, storytelling.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: High production value, distribution, storytelling, community engagement, measurement.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Ad-blocker proof, deep engagement, brand affinity, earned media value.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Markets requiring constant adaptation, innovation, and strategic pivots.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: Long-term survival, first-mover advantage, resilience, continuous reinvention.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: R&D pipelines, agile governance, pivot frameworks, sensing/seizing/transforming.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: Long-term survival, first-mover advantage, resilience, sustained competitive advantage.

st_gallen_magic_triangle.who: Non-customers, uncontested markets, and overlooked segments.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.what: No competition, premium pricing, rule-maker status, value innovation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.how: Value innovation, ERRC grid (Eliminate-Reduce-Raise-Create), market education, new demand creation.
st_gallen_magic_triangle.why: No competition, premium pricing, rule-maker status, uncontested market capture.

cross_walk_mapping.description: How the 54 individual models map to the 12 Universal Archetypes.

helmer_7_powers_matrix.scale_economies: Spreading fixed costs (R&D, Marketing) over higher volume. (Models: SaaS, Manufacturing, DTC, IaaS)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.network_economies: Value increases as users join. (Models: Platforms, Marketplaces, UGC, Network Effect)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.counter_positioning: A newcomer adopts a superior, uncopyable business model. (Models: Blue Ocean, Netflix vs Blockbuster, Tesla)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.switching_costs: High friction to leave. (Models: SaaS, B2B Platforms, Ecosystems, Subscriptions)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.branding: Psychological attribution of value. (Models: DTC, Luxury, Licensing, Franchise)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.cornered_resource: Preferential access to a valuable asset. (Models: Licensing, Franchising, Mining, IaaS)
helmer_7_powers_matrix.process_power: Embedded, hard-to-replicate company culture and processes. (Models: Toyota Lean, Consulting Firms, Manufacturing)

phase_1_validation.focus: Market testing, low capital expenditure, rapid iteration.

phase_2_scaling.focus: User acquisition, network effects, recurring revenue stabilization.

phase_3_domination.focus: Market consolidation, barrier to entry creation, M&A.
